title: lean-malliavin
summary: Malliavin calculus on abstract Gaussian Banach spaces, formalized in Lean 4 against Mathlib. The repository contains two Comparator configurations: one registered (core, via comparator.json, pinned at commit 29c57b3) and one pending (Clark--Ocone, via comparator-clark-ocone.json). The proof library (52 files) builds from Cameron--Martin quasi-invariance through the Wiener chaos decomposition and Itô isometry to the full representation formula.
